records.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create one polished original illustrated YouTube storytime thumbnail, opaque 16:9 landscape. Input images are REFERENCE images, not edit targets: image1 supplies typography/background/graphic hierarchy only, do not copy its anime characters or screenshot UI; image2 supplies the approved flat illustrated promotional finish, do not copy its teacher, phone, school or secrecy story; image3 supplies actual EP11 Nemi identity and wardrobe. Preserve recognizable Nemi: long straight red-orange auburn hair, distinctive center pointed bangs and single ahoge, very large emerald-green eyes with simple ink highlights, warm peach face, cheek hatch marks, sage green high-neck hoodie with drawstrings, dark crossbody strap. Warm dark burgundy linework, clean flat illustrated fills and a little soft cel shading, human hand-drawn personality. Do not turn Nemi into a generic manga heroine or realistic portrait. Use large character and story prop shapes with clean thick white cutout separation and occasional red outer edging. A single headline in very heavy broad WHITE sans-serif display letters with clearly distinct thick BLACK inner, bright RED middle and BLACK outer contours, matching the supplied promotional references; huge and legible, safely inset from all edges. No secondary text, no fine-print labels, no logos, no screenshot UI, no watermarks, no timestamp badge. Emotional promise: Nemi is sincerely worried about falling views and reaching ad monetization before February, grateful for existing supporters, still creating stories. Do not imply the channel is deleted, banned, closing, a final goodbye, or that subscribers caused the problem. No fabricated analytics values or testimonial quotes. Leave the lower-right platform duration area without essential text.
Concept A, emotional direct appeal. Text verbatim: "I'M SCARED..." Place the single headline across the upper strip. Below it, Nemi fills the right 55% in a shoulder/chest portrait facing the viewer: brows gently raised inward, emerald eyes visibly worried, mouth small and uncertain, shoulders a little gathered. One open hand close to her chest, clean anatomically plausible fingers, no dramatic crying. Left side: a large tilted off-white hand-drawn video card with a simple red play triangle, and one bold rose-plum line graph above/on it showing a past spike easing into low reach. The graph is symbolic with no labels or numbers, supports the feeling instead of pretending to be a real analytics screenshot. Two tiny loose pencil accents at most. Background bright white and pale coral/white checkerboard, clear open space and fresh graphic contrast. Make Nemi and the headline the obvious first read; the quiet video/graph motif is second. This is an honest vulnerable creator appeal, warm rather than horror.
records.headline: I'M SCARED...
records.title: I Really Need Your Help

Concept B, distinct ticking-time metaphor. Text verbatim: "FOUR MONTHS..." Make a bold two-line headline occupy the upper left, not the same staging as concept A. Nemi is a large expressive portrait on the left/lower center leaning around an oversized illustrated hourglass on the right. She looks at its falling sand with a nervous thoughtful expression, one hand supporting its lower wooden frame and the other lightly touching the side; wrists and grips clean, five fingers only where naturally visible, no crossed impossible hands. The hourglass contains a very small red video play shape above the sand pile, representing the creator goal and time pressure, not a banned/dead channel. In the lower bulb, warm muted amber sand; top bulb still contains sand, showing there is time left. Keep the hourglass outline plum and its fill largely white, graphic silhouette. Sparse hand-drawn clock ticks behind it, no calendars with extra text or numbers. Background bright white/pale mint checkerboard, with selective amber and rose only on the sand and small focus accents. White/red cutout edges, flat warm storytime illustration, strong readable face and heavy headline. The idea must be deadline pressure while still hopeful, no giant tears or shouting.
records.headline: FOUR MONTHS...
